rationale: July 23-24 Reuters/AFP/Motorsport reports from Hungaroring reveal Malaysia (Sepang International Circuit) is actively assessing an F1 proposal to replace Bahrain GP on Oct 4 ahead of Singapore, with Portimao (Algarve International Circuit / Autodromo Internacional do Algarve), Istanbul Park, and Barcelona also under consideration ahead of the FIA WMSC weekend vote.
